references.name: set-E2-r1
references.prompt:
I need a photograph-like image that will be used as a reference picture for an AI image model. Because it is a reference, technical correctness matters more than anything else: the AI will copy exactly what it sees, including any mistake. So I am not going to describe how the work is done. You will take that entirely from real photographs: search Google Images for real photographs of the subject below, study how it is really done, and build the picture from them. If anything I ask for below contradicts what the real photographs show, the photographs win.
One rule above all: show one way of doing it, as one real photograph would. Real photographs will show you more than one method of doing the same thing. Do not combine them into a single picture, and do not add elements from one method to another. Choose the one method that appears most often in the photographs, or the one most typical of the place I describe, and show only that, exactly as it appears in those photographs, with nothing added. Everything in the picture must be justified by a single, consistent way of working; if two details could not both be true at the same time on one real site, one of them does not belong. Mention the other methods you saw only in your notes, not in the picture.

This is a set of three pictures of the same one subject on the same site, made one per turn: I name each picture's view in its turn; keep every detail the same across the set, each picture adding the view the others lack. Deliver each picture as one separate output image at full size, never as a collage, grid or split frame, with no borders, numbers or captions inside any picture. Say what each picture adds.

What the picture must represent: the kiln during firing.

Cosmetic requirements, which do not touch the technical content:
- The place reads as yard, day; the film's look: warm daylight.
- Natural daylight as in that place, natural colours, no filters, no stylisation, no illustration.
- Camera close enough that the subject is readable, the surroundings soft.
- No person, no text, logos, watermarks, stock-site lettering or maker's stamps; nothing in the picture that the real photographs do not justify.

With the pictures, tell me: (1) the one method you chose and why, and the other methods you saw in the photographs but left out; (2) what you found in the real photographs and which findings you implemented; (3) anything in my request that the photographs contradicted and what you did instead; (4) the web pages and images you consulted, with URLs.

references.name: set-P1-r1
references.prompt:
Character sheet of Mason (P1), a person in this film.
Who they are: the mason who lays the plinth.
Fixed look: a man of about forty, lean, dark skin, short grey hair, a thin moustache, a cotton lungi folded to the knee and a faded shirt.
Garments: a white lungi and a blue shirt.
Place: yard, day; the film's look: warm daylight.
Why: kneels all day.
Make a set of three separate pictures of this one person, one per turn: 1, a full-length front view standing at ease; 2, a full-length three-quarter view in a working pose of their trade; 3, a close-up of the face. Deliver each as one separate output image at full size, never a collage, grid or split frame; the same person in every picture in every detail; alone on plain neutral ground, nothing else in the frame; no text, numbers or captions inside any picture.
